metadata.description: Claude Code skills for content creators: research, scripting, writing, offer, visuals.

plugins.name: hemingway
plugins.description: Sentence-by-sentence readability filter calibrated to your voice rules. OK / ~ / X grading + clean rewrite.

plugins.name: script-writer
plugins.description: Idea or competitor reel to a short-form script: 10 scored hooks, beat map with re-hooks every 6-8s and proof on screen, quality gate, in your voice.

plugins.name: daily-threads
plugins.description: Turn a brain-dump into a full day of ready-to-post Threads/X posts. Proven templates, hook bank, anti-AI-detection filter.

plugins.name: anti-slop-interview
plugins.description: 30-min interview that loads your voice, anti-AI rules and offer into ~/CLAUDE.md, so Claude sounds like you.

plugins.name: offer-builder
plugins.description: 60-min interview to decide what to sell (course, product, tool, service): 3 tailored ideas + your one-liner.

plugins.name: outliers
plugins.description: YouTube outlier detection on any topic (views vs channel median) + title variants adapted to your niche.

plugins.name: ig-competitor-research
plugins.description: Weekly Instagram competitor research via Chrome: ranks reels by views, pulls first-3s hooks + transcripts, HTML report.

plugins.name: video-breakdown
plugins.description: Break any video into visuals + audio: timestamped frames, contact sheets, local Whisper transcript. Free, no API.

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe any video URL (IG, TikTok, YouTube, X...) with local Whisper. Free, no API key.

plugins.name: mindcraft
plugins.description: Local AI image generation on Apple Silicon via MindCraft Studio + Z-Image Turbo. $0 per image, IG-ready 1080x1350.

plugins.name: competitor-report
plugins.description: Report on an Instagram competitor from a profile link: outlier reels vs their median (sponsored flagged), audience, offer, ideas for you. Official API + transcripts.

plugins.name: content-ideas
plugins.description: Scan your competitor list for recent organic outlier reels that fit your audience, and adapt each one into your version with 3 hooks. Needs competitor-report.
